prompt: Create a photorealistic cinematic product photograph of a sleek modern countertop microwave oven in a warm minimalist kitchen. The microwave is the single main subject, positioned slightly right of center on a stone countertop, with a rounded rectangular beige-bronze metal body, black glass front door, thin chrome trim, small feet, and a right-side control panel. The control panel has a soft white digital display reading 0:50 above one large circular metal dial surrounded by tiny minimal tick marks and plus/minus-style symbols. Through the dark perforated microwave window, show a warm amber interior light illuminating one shallow ceramic bowl centered on the turntable. The surrounding kitchen is calm and upscale: a large window on the left with blurred greenery outside, sunlight casting soft leaf-shaped shadows across the counter, one ceramic vase with leafy branches behind the microwave on the left, one empty ceramic bowl on the counter in the left foreground, and one floating wooden shelf in the background holding two stacked books, one rounded vase, one small plate stack, and a trailing plant at the far right. Use earthy neutral colors, matte textures, soft golden-hour side lighting, shallow depth of field, realistic reflections on glass and metal, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, and a premium appliance-advertising composition. No people, no logos, no extra text beyond the digital timer.

promptZh: 创作一张照片级真实的电影感产品摄影图，展示一台置于温暖极简风格厨房中的现代台式微波炉。微波炉作为唯一的主体，位于石质台面中心偏右的位置，机身为圆角矩形的米青铜色金属材质，配有黑色玻璃前门、纤细的镀铬饰条、小巧的底座以及右侧控制面板。控制面板上有一个柔和的白色数字显示屏，显示 0:50，下方是一个大型圆形金属旋钮，周围环绕着极简的刻度标记和加减号符号。透过微波炉深色的网孔视窗，可以看到内部温暖的琥珀色灯光照亮了转盘中央的一个浅口陶瓷碗。周围的厨房环境宁静且高端：左侧有一扇大窗户，窗外是模糊的绿植，阳光在台面上投下柔和的叶影；微波炉左后方摆放着一个插有枝叶的陶瓷花瓶，左前方台面上有一个空陶瓷碗；背景中有一个悬浮木质搁板，上面放着两本叠放的书、一个圆形花瓶、一叠小盘子，最右侧垂下一株植物。采用大地色系的中性色调、哑光质感、柔和的黄金时刻侧光、浅景深效果、玻璃与金属的真实反射、细腻的胶片颗粒感、高动态范围，以及高端家电广告的构图。画面中不包含人物、品牌 Logo，除数字计时器外无任何额外文字。
